description: Intelligent Document Processing - parse PDF, DOCX, and image files into pipeline documents

parse_pdf.name: Parse PDF
parse_pdf.description: Extract the native text layer of a PDF page by page with layout hints

parse_docx.name: Parse DOCX
parse_docx.description: Extract paragraphs and tables from a DOCX file

load_image.name: Load Image
load_image.description: Normalize TIFF, PNG, or JPEG images into a pipeline document

parse_scanned_pdf.name: Parse Scanned PDF
parse_scanned_pdf.description: OCR a scanned PDF with local Tesseract plus optional VLM fallback for low-confidence pages, with per-page provenance
parse_scanned_pdf.output: Dictionary with per-page text, engine and confidence provenance plus warnings

path.label: Path
path.description: Path to the scanned PDF file

pages.label: Pages
pages.description: Optional 1-based pages to process, e.g. '1,3-5'. All pages by default

min_confidence.label: Min Confidence
min_confidence.description: Mean word-confidence (0..1) below which a page escalates to VLM

vlm_fallback.label: VLM Fallback
vlm_fallback.description: Re-read low-confidence pages via the multimodal LLM provider (sends page images externally)
